diff --git a/test/units/cli/test_doc.py b/test/units/cli/test_doc.py
index d93b5aa..5046014 100644
--- a/test/units/cli/test_doc.py
+++ b/test/units/cli/test_doc.py
@@ -4,7 +4,7 @@ __metaclass__ = type
 
 import pytest
 
-from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI
+from ansible.cli.doc import DocCLI, RoleMixin
 
 
 TTY_IFY_DATA = {
@@ -33,3 +33,58 @@ TTY_IFY_DATA = {
 @pytest.mark.parametrize('text, expected', sorted(TTY_IFY_DATA.items()))
 def test_ttyify(text, expected):
     assert DocCLI.tty_ify(text) == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('collection, expected_name', [('', 'example'), ('namespace.collection', 'namespace.collection.example')])
+def test_role_build_doc(collection, expected_name):
+    main = {'short_description': 'Main', 'options': {'value': {'type': 'str'}}}
+    alternate = {'short_description': 'Alternate'}
+    argspec = {'main': main, 'alternate': alternate}
+
+    fqcn, doc = RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', collection, argspec)
+
+    assert fqcn == expected_name
+    assert doc == {
+        'path': '/roles/example',
+        'collection': collection,
+        'entry_points': argspec,
+    }
+    assert doc['entry_points']['main'] is main
+
+
+def test_role_build_doc_filters_entry_points():
+    main = {'short_description': 'Main'}
+    alternate = {'short_description': 'Alternate'}
+    argspec = {'main': main, 'alternate': alternate}
+
+    fqcn, doc = RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', 'namespace.collection', argspec, 'alternate')
+
+    assert fqcn == 'namespace.collection.example'
+    assert doc == {
+        'path': '/roles/example',
+        'collection': 'namespace.collection',
+        'entry_points': {'alternate': alternate},
+    }
+    assert doc['entry_points']['alternate'] is alternate
+    assert argspec == {'main': main, 'alternate': alternate}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('argspec, entry_point', [({}, None), ({'main': {}}, 'missing')])
+def test_role_build_doc_without_matching_entry_points(argspec, entry_point):
+    assert RoleMixin()._build_doc('example', '/roles/example', '', argspec, entry_point) == ('example', None)
+
+
+def test_create_role_doc_omits_roles_without_matching_entry_point(monkeypatch):
+    mixin = RoleMixin()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mixin, '_find_all_normal_roles', lambda *args, **kwargs: {('example', '/roles/example')})
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mixin, '_find_all_collection_roles', lambda *args, **kwargs: set())
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mixin, '_load_argspec', lambda *args, **kwargs: {'main': {'short_description': 'Main'}})
+
+    assert mixin._create_role_doc(('example',), ('/roles',), entry_point='missing') == {}
+    assert mixin._create_role_doc(('example',), ('/roles',), entry_point='main') == {
+        'example': {
+            'path': '/roles/example',
+            'collection': '',
+            'entry_points': {'main': {'short_description': 'Main'}},
+        },
+    }
